items.headline: KCB reclaim top spot as Alpha rescues Gor again
items.summary: KCB returned to the top of the SportPesa Premier League standings after edging league debutants 3K FC 1-0 at Police Sacco Stadium to maintain their push for the title.

items.headline: Talanta, Kasarani stadia to host AFCON 2027 matches
items.summary: Tanzanias Arusha and Zanzibar, Ugandas Kampala and Kenyas Nairobi named as 2027 AFCON host cities; CAF says matches to be played at seven Stadiums.
